summary: Nextest starts 55 more long tests (15 to 75 seconds) early, at priority 50 below the existing priority-100 tests, so a run no longer ends on a tail of 20 to 30 second tests started late. The four native delivery probe tests had lost their place when the single test the old priority list named was split. Order only: no test is selected, retried or changed differently.

replay.detail: Test scheduling only; no claim, replay or projection change.

rules.detail: No rule, permission or trust change.

compatibility.detail: No wire, CLI or client change.

downtime.detail: Nothing runs differently on installed machines.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit to return to binary order for these tests.
